title: Why Dario Amodei Left OpenAI
structureWhy: Open on the interviewer asking the question viewers already have. The answer then unfolds as expectation, correction, evidence, and consequence. Consecutive clip:2 and clip:3 keep Dario's trust argument intact without announcing a false speaker handoff.

source.speaker: Dario Amodei
source.comment: 4K landscape extraction from the publisher upload. Passage boundaries are refined from a transcription of this exact working file before render.
source.passagesWhy: 0 asks the question cleanly. 1 keeps Dario's concession that safety disagreements existed and his explicit statement that they were not sufficient to leave. 2 names trust and stated values. 3 lands the consequence: he could no longer continue to work with or trust the company. 4 gives Dario the final word: market and public opinion speak louder than drama.
source.subjectFocusWhy: The interviewer sits left of centre and Dario sits right of centre. A modest centre-right crop keeps both solo angles readable while preserving looking room.

publish.title: Why Dario Amodei Left OpenAI
publish.description:
Dario Amodei says safety disagreements alone were not why he left OpenAI. The breaking point, in his account, was trust.

Source: Bloomberg Originals — The Circuit with Emily Chang
Commentary and edit: The Next Curve

rights.speaker: Dario Amodei
rights.note: Short excerpts are evidence for an original, attributed commentary. Narration supplies the editorial spine; source is credited in the description.

captionCorrectionsWhy: The source ASR lowercased Anthropic and split OpenAI into two words. Proper-name corrections are authored here because clip captions have no script authority.
